tips: Your best of this type so far: the benchmark to beat. The goal is still zero.
Overstood the layline by ~7°. Tack onto it a little sooner and sail the last 100 m at full upwind speed.
Came out at 43° to the wind, low and wide (your best exited at 26°). Finish the turn close to close-hauled; the wide entry is what makes a tight exit possible.
Took 80 s to settle upwind (best 44 s). Trim main and jib on through the turn, then speed before height.
Speed dropped 35% through the turn (5.23 → 3.4 kt; best 27%). A smoother, rounder turn with trim in step with the helm keeps more of it.
